Assign rows using agglomerative clustering.

Clusters selected numeric features and appends an Int32 cluster_id column. Ward linkage requires Euclidean distance.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `HierarchicalCluster` |
| Search words | hierarchical, dendrogram, agglomerative |

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table containing numeric features |

## Outputs

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Columns | Feature columns | `feature_cols` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Comma-separated numeric features; empty auto-detects numeric columns. |

|   | n_clusters | `n_clusters` | Integer | `3` | `1-2147483647` | The run | Number of clusters. |
|   | linkage | `linkage` | Choice | `ward` | `ward`, `complete`, `average`, `single` | The run | Linkage method. |
|   | metric | `metric` | Choice | `euclidean` | `euclidean`, `manhattan`, `cosine` | The run | Distance metric. |
|   | standardise | `standardise` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Scale each feature to z-scores before fitting (Explore > Groups does) |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
